medium: Original digital paintings generated for this film using OpenAI ImageGen. Existing game art informed the visual brief. No modern external illustration was supplied.
use: Production film artwork. Documentary references identify the underlying historical event. The painted compositions are reconstructions.

assets.description: Departing from Sydney heads. Slight crop removes an invented margin heading. The rig, angle and weather are a reconstruction of departure, S003/S004.
Grafton approaching the rocks at midnight. Read with Musgrave’s account of the second anchor dragging (S001, pp. 2–5).
Crew bracing below the reefed sail in a small open boat. A gale caught the three men soon after their departure (S001, p. 96).
Three occupants in their open dinghy during the crossing. The particular night, moon, clothing and disposition of the crew are illustrative (S001, pp. 96–97).
A man supports the exhausted Musgrave at Port Adventure. The approach, view and clothing are reconstructed from an episode in S001, pp. 96–97.
An interior crop focuses on hands, cups and food offered at Captain Cross’s house. Utensils, seating and gestures are an interpretation (S001, pp. 96–97).
Two Invercauld survivors travel in a small skin boat. The joins, paddle and angle are reconstructed from Smith’s published letter (S038), not a surviving portrait of his boat.
